settings.name: OIDF_FAPI2_CLIENTS
settings.description: The FAPI clients, space- or comma-separated; * is every client. The FAPI 2.0 filter holds them to issuer-only assertion audiences and PS256, ES256 or EdDSA DPoP proofs, and at UserInfo the resource-server filter sets x-fapi-interaction-id for them and refuses their access tokens in the query

when_wrong.detail: A list of nothing (a comma alone): FAPI does not start. An id that names no client holds nobody

settings.name: OIDF_FAPI_RESOURCE_CLIENTS
settings.description: More clients the resource-server filter holds to the FAPI rules at UserInfo (x-fapi-interaction-id set, access tokens in the query refused), space- or comma-separated; * is every client. For FAPI 1.0 clients, such as FAPI-CIBA's, whose token requests are not the FAPI 2.0 filter's to judge; the clients OIDF_FAPI2_CLIENTS lists are held to the rules without being named here

when_wrong.detail: A list of nothing (a comma alone): the rules apply to every client at UserInfo, and a warning says so. An id that names no client holds nobody
